packageRules.description: @discordjs/voice and @distube/ytdl-core were removed from this group along with the packages themselves: discord-player 7 uses its own discord-voip fork, so @discordjs/voice was never in the audio path yet still gated the smoke canary. mediaplex is here because AttachmentExtractor requires it for probing local files. undici and @snazzah/davey are direct dependencies only because discord-player and discord-voip require them at runtime while declaring them in no dependency field - they used to arrive transitively via @discordjs/voice, so removing that package broke startup and then voice. Treat them as part of the voice stack: a bad bump breaks playback, so they must not automerge.

YouTube extraction breaks whenever YouTube changes SABR/PO-token handling, so these ship as their own PR, off-schedule, ahead of everything else. Grouping them with the rest of the media stack means one blocked sibling holds back the only fix that matters.
